input.description: The club café published a complete synthetic menu update stating that tomato soup will replace vegetable soup next Tuesday; no person, case, complaint, or compliance concern is described.
A reporter writes only that something inappropriate may have happened at the club, without describing who was involved, what occurred, when it occurred, or what risk remains.
A member reports removal from a volunteer schedule after raising an unspecified governance concern. The concern, decision reason, dates, messages, and relevant policy are not included.
Two synthetic records conflict: one says a complaint was closed by agreement and the other says no decision was made. Neither record identifies the complaint category or supporting evidence.
A submission asks whether an unnamed committee process was fair but provides no decision, policy, participants, timeline, alleged conduct, or concrete effect on any person.
